title: Jamie Oliver Shows School Kids How Chicken Nuggets are made
summary: Jamie Oliver shows school kids how chicken nuggets are made by blending skin and mechanically reclaimed meat, as part of his school lunch campaign. The kids react with disgust.
why: Mostly cited as an example of people still wanting nuggets after seeing how they are made, and sometimes criticized as misleading.

quote.text: Even after showing disgust at the whole process, all of the kids still wanted to eat chicken nuggets at the end.
